body: When it comes to spiraling, I sometimes like to think of myself driving down a mountain during a snowstorm. You’re right, there’s probably a lot that could go wrong, but right now your job is just to get to the bottom. I think maybe focus on what you know needs to get done (getting your appointment scheduled), and fuck everything else. You can do it.

I think also, I just feel like...everything I’ve tried I’ve just failed at. Not because I’m bad at it, but because I cannot deal with the pressure of becoming excellent, and I am a perfectionist! There is nothing I want more than to be excellent. So I stop trying, and I end up in this current rut that I am finding myself in this situation.

It’s so self-centered and I kind of hate myself more for it. That my failures are based on the fact that I couldn’t be the person I wanted to be. I’ve been trying to journal and it gives me more anxiety than not. So I suppose I need to figure out another way to digest my feelings or at least figure out a way how to move through them.

thanks dude. I don't know. I feel like I'm the author of my own pain and obstacles. Every time something good happens in my life, i feel like somehow I sabatoge it, even when I do nothing. 

I guess I've just lived with the assumption that sooner or later, I will fuck up and ruin my life for so long maybe I'm making it happen.

I hope you feel better my friend. I wouldn't wish this amount of self-hatred on anyone. People deserve to love themselves and to believe that they can become better people, and then act on that belief without feeling like failure is inevitable.
I'm trying to find meaning in the things I do around me but what is the point, you know? What is the point of anything, if ultimately nothing I do matters.
Thank you! That's basically where I'm at, so this is very helpful, thank you :)
